end.parentNote: Kavya practised connecting Baisakhi and Pongal with ready or harvested crops. They first said festival dates were random, but later corrected this and explained that festivals are celebrated when crops are ready. They also identified Makar Sankranti traditions such as til-gud and kite flying; next, ask them to describe one regional festival using food, clothes, decorations, or flowers.
